# Requirements Quality Checklist: Public Car Marketplace

**Purpose**: Standard pre-implementation review of whether the marketplace requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before implementation. This checklist tests the requirements writing. It does not test the product.
**Created**: 2026-11-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the facts a public listing must show specified for both the browse result and the detail page? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the personal facts limited to account email, display name, and password, plus inquiry name, email, optional phone, and message? [Completeness, Spec §A-16]
- [ ] CHK003 Are payments, financing, shipping, auctions, in-app chat, in-product replies, password reset, email verification, listing deletion, staff moderation, keyword search, video, and buyer accounts explicitly out of scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK004 Is behavior specified for a catalog larger than one page, including a page size of 20 and a way to request a later page? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements specified for who may read inquiries and what a person who is not the owner is told? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the 14-day sign-in duration specific about whether later activity renews that period? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the password rule specific about a maximum length, or does it state only a minimum of 8 characters? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "still image" defined as an allowed set of image kinds, or as every non-video image? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the inquiry confirmation's "names the car" defined as particular listing facts? [Clarity, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK010 Is location specified as one free-text city-and-region value rather than two separate fields? [Clarity, Spec §A-05, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "one inquiry" specified as a single non-threaded message, or as a limit of one inquiry per person per listing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Ambiguity]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the default browse rules agree across User Story 1, FR-002, FR-003, and the edge cases on available-only results, newest-published order, page size, and combined filters? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Does status terminology agree on the words Available and Sold, including the filter choice described as "both"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK014 Do sold-listing requirements agree that a sold car leaves the default browse and remains readable when opened directly? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Do privacy requirements agree that seller email, phone, and street address stay off the public listing, while inquiry contact details are available to the owner? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-016]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Are the Independent Test descriptions for all four stories measurable from their stated preconditions and outcomes? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK017 Can the listing-fact and ownership outcomes be judged from a stated sample or attempt set? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the visitor, seller, and buyer time limits tied to a defined start and finish for each journey? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the 500-listing response target quantified with a page scope and a time limit? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the first-attempt completion outcome quantified with a participant task, a completion definition, and the 90% threshold? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are primary requirements present for browse, publish, correction and status change, and inquiry? [Coverage, Spec §US1, Spec §US2, Spec §US3, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK022 Are alternate filter requirements specified for available only, sold only, and both, with empty filter fields ignored? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK023 Are exception requirements specified for a duplicate email, a mismatched sign-in, invalid listing facts, a sold listing, and an inquiry by the owner? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK024 Are refusal outcomes specified so that a rejected publish leaves no partial public listing and a rejected photo change keeps the previous photos? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Spec §US3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 Are the empty-catalog outcome and the no-match outcome specified as distinct, non-error results? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are inclusive bounds specified for year, price, mileage, text length, photo count, and photo size? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Is behavior specified when the owner saves more than once, and when someone other than the owner attempts a change? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK028 Is behavior specified for a still image that is outside JPEG, PNG, and WebP? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Conflict]
- [ ] CHK029 Is behavior specified when a seller attempts to publish or edit after the session has ended, including the fate of unsaved entries? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK030 Are response-time requirements quantified for the first browse page and a detail page at 500 published listings? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK031 Are accessibility requirements specified for keyboard use, visible focus, text alternatives for photos, and status that is not conveyed by color alone? [Non-Functional, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK032 Are security requirements specified for how a failed sign-in is explained, how long a session lasts, and which secrets must stay out of public listing facts? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009, Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 Is an abuse or rate threshold specified for registration, sign-in, and inquiries, or is that threshold absent from the requirements? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [ ] CHK034 Is English specified as the only required language for the copy a visitor, seller, or buyer must read? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-020]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK035 Are assumptions A-01 through A-16 recorded as confirmation items, with the affected requirement identified if an assumption is wrong? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK036 Does the specification leave the Next.js, .NET, and MySQL boundary out of product behavior, page structure, and storage design? [Dependency, Spec §A-14]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK037 Is a 128-character password ceiling stated in the requirements, or does it conflict with the acceptance scenario that requires only at least 8 characters? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK038 Is a valid email format defined for registration and inquiries, or is format rejection unspecified? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-014]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Depth for this run: Standard. Audience: reviewer, before implementation. Focus: public discovery, accountable selling, inquiry without a transaction, and measurable bounds.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
